tools.name: search_issuers
tools.description: Find issuers of corporate bonds listed on GPW Catalyst (Poland) by name, ticker prefix or sector. Returns name, sector, number of listed series, next maturity and the source page. Szukanie emitentów obligacji korporacyjnych z Catalyst.

tools.name: get_issuer_bonds
tools.description: List all bond series of one issuer listed on GPW Catalyst: code, maturity date, issue value, coupon type, base rate, margin, current coupon. Serie obligacji jednego emitenta z terminami wykupu i oprocentowaniem.

tools.name: get_bond
tools.description: Details of one Catalyst bond series by its code (e.g. "KRU1226"): ISIN, issuer, maturity, coupon terms, collateral, issue value, upcoming interest payment dates and the financial covenant from the terms of issue with a quote and source document, plus data_quality per field (confirmed by a document,

tools.name: get_calendar
tools.description: Calendar of the Catalyst corporate bond market for a date range: maturities (redemptions), interest payments and open public offers. Default range: next 30 days; maximum 366 days and 100 rows per call. Kalendarz wykupów, wypłat odsetek i zapisów na emisje.
